summary: Retest after seed data was populated. All 9 browser checks and 6 backend test files pass (15/15). The previously blocked criterion 'Canais e busca degradam com segurança' is now fully verified: GET /api/channels returns the 5 seeded channels (whatsapp, facebook, internet, visual, mcp), the Canais page renders channel-card-* elements, the internet card's search panel is reachable, config PATCH persists, and invalid status is rejected (422). DuckDuckGo search degrades safely to an empty result list without breaking the page, per spec_deviations.
